newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $388 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $388 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the Tuesday, April 22 are expected to total $388 million in 29 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $276 million in seven sales, with a $150 million King County, Wash., deal through Smith Barney Inc. is topping the list.
On the competitive side, 22 sales totaling $111 million are on the schedule. A $36 million Evanston, Ill., deal at 1200 EDT is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $124 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
